newsitem.title: USA: Toll Brothers calling notes, sees Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Toll Brothers calling notes, sees Q1 charge.

text.p: Toll Brothers Inc said on March 15 it will redeem all of its 10.5 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002 at 103 percent of principal amount plus accrued interest.
It said the redemption will result in a first quarter extraordinary charge of about $0.07 per share.
In August, Toll Brothers secured a $50 million forward commitment for a five-year term loan priced at 7.82 percent, which it plans to draw down on March 17.
In addition, it recently completed an offering of $100 million senior subordinated notes due November 2006 at a coupon rate of 8.75 percent.
Toll said it expects to use these sources of funds to redeem all of the $88 million of 10.5 percent senior subordinated notes outstanding.
